Taco Bell and Habit Burger & Grill will move their shared headquarters to a larger 254,000-square-foot campus at Alton HQ in Irvine by 2028.

The Bright Side:
Orange County's largest office lease in five years secures local jobs and boosts regional economic vitality.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Evaluating a standard corporate real estate transaction on physical and economic planes without hidden moral distortion.

The Trajectory: The Path of Grace.
When you map transparent economic investment to tangible campus expansion, it plots a direct trajectory toward Grace. Aligned incentives produce mutual corporate and community benefit.

The Unavoidable Lie: This routine corporate real estate transaction represents a revolutionary shift in fast-food culture.
